name: projects
description: Read the project owners, purpose and data-handling review dates.

name: suites
description: Read versioned acceptance suites and their review dates.

name: cases
description: Inspect the exact expected answers, assertions and latency limits.

name: runs
description: Read coverage, saved outcomes, reviews and evidence freshness.

name: run
description: Read one run with its saved evidence and notes.

name: observations
description: Inspect recorded answers and source call references.

name: score
description: Preview every case against the recorded answers. Missing answers fail.

name: evaluate
description: Save the complete input snapshot and per-case outcomes under the actual evaluator name.

name: results
description: Read current saved results. Stop when the evidence is stale.

name: compare
description: Compare two current evaluations with identical case definitions and show each regression.

name: cohorts
description: Count passes and failures by the business group attached to each case.

name: failures
description: Read the failed checks, including missing answers and latency problems.

name: attention
description: Find incomplete, failed, stale or overdue runs.

name: compliance
description: Read data-handling and suite-review dates. These are review reminders, not legal certification.

name: reviews
description: Read the review history tied to each saved evaluation.

name: actions
description: Read follow-up work, owners, due dates and resolution evidence.

name: add-project
description: Register the real owner, purpose and agreed access and retention review dates. These dates are local policy.

name: add-suite
description: Register a named version of the acceptance suite. Resolve the project first.

name: add-case
description: Read examples/case.json and write the agreed test case to a private staging file. Never invent the expected answer.

name: add-run
description: Create an answer set for a stated model or prompt version and actual producer.

name: record
description: Read examples/observation.json. Record an actual output and measured latency. Never fabricate an answer or timing.

name: review
description: Read current results and open actions first. A real different reviewer approves only complete passing evaluations. Never invent a second identity.

name: add-action
description: Register a concrete failure to fix, an actual owner and an agreed due date.

name: close-action
description: Record the actual resolution evidence and operator identity. Closing work does not change old scores.

name: log
description: Append the actual decision or observation to the run history.

name: history
description: Read notes in order before preparing a review.

name: import
description: Read docs/replace-wandb-weave.md. Inspect the export and explicit mapping. Get the independent source count. Dry-run, reconcile, then import. No credentials are required here.

name: export
description: Write the full database contents to a new private JSON file. Keep source exports separately. Never overwrite an existing backup.

name: weekly-review
description: Draft the Monday review from attention, open actions and compliance. Return the generated file in chat. Never send it.

name: draft-review
description: Draft a decision packet from current saved results and the actual review history. Return the generated file in chat. It does not authorise a deployment.

description: customise

description: new-view

description: views
